review_basis: overnight rendered master, not old handoff verdicts

findings.observation: The Hall B map at f834-905 looks polished, then f906 cuts to visible wall and floor dirt. Discovery and final-clean state are insufficiently distinguished.
replacement: Roshan notices a visible dust patch below the room emblems.
She points toward it without cleaning or collecting anything.
Her hand settles and the grime remains visible.

findings.observation: Native f1028-1074 shows brush ripples and lifted black drips while the basin remains dark; the next shot jumps to a spotless wide.
replacement: Roshan plants the brush on a small visible dirty strip inside the tub.
One short scrub moves grime into the bristles and exposes the same tub surface underneath.
She lifts the brush after the clean strip is readable.

findings.observation: The clean wide introduces prominent foreground storage and a changed composition; review its room geography against the dirty entry rather than accepting brightness alone.
replacement: Start after completed bathroom gameplay in the same room and camera address as discovery.
Roshan looks from the now-clean tub toward the same sink and toilet.
She gives one small satisfied nod and settles.

findings.observation: The short retained plug shot has mostly sustained hand contact; a water jet follows quickly. Preserve a readable hand-to-plug separation rather than letting the jet conceal disposal.
replacement: Roshan closes one hand on the visible mouth obstruction.
She pulls it wholly clear of the spout and holds it to the side.
The first small stream emerges only from the unblocked mouth.

findings.observation: Frames 1464/1465 cut directly from murky water beneath the rainbow flow to a fully turquoise pool. The cleaning consequence is missing.
replacement: From the waterfall and seahorse outlets, two low clear-water fronts spread over the dirty surface.
The fronts travel toward one another while brown water recedes only behind them.
They meet; the last dirty patch clears and the surface settles before Rumi appears.

findings.observation: At f1990/1991 the view switches to foreground stations while loose supplies cease to be legible. A new angle does not explain where the mess went.
replacement: Roshan looks at one loose supply group in the established dirty room.
She approaches and points, leaving every loose supply and grime patch visible.
She settles before the player’s collection begins.

findings.observation: Consecutive f2039-2086 shows a glowing brush traversing a persistent purple patch. The cleaning effect is much less legible than the sparkles.
replacement: Roshan lowers the brush onto the purple grime at the near supply island.
She makes one short wipe; the grime rolls into the bristles behind the contact edge.
She stops and lifts the brush, revealing a clean strip without changing the tabletop.

findings.observation: The cut ends on an approaching pose at f2119. There is no readable arrival/contact/settle payoff, and the recap repeats this incomplete beat.
replacement: Roshan finishes the short approach to the low workbench after completed gameplay.
She gently places her palms on its near edge, eyes following her hands.
She settles and smiles at the clean blank workspace.

findings.observation: The incoming group appears at a cut and contact is uneven. The new owner-directed reveal requires all four helpers visibly working on the same old dust-bunny shell.
replacement: The big lavender dust bunny retains his own spiral ears, forehead curl, face and pearls while all four helpers begin scrubbing; obvious wet soap lather appears at every tool contact.
Everyone keeps scrubbing as white pale-blue suds and translucent bubbles spread from those contact patches over his body and ears.
His recognizable outline becomes lost under a billowing blanket of soap bubbles; the little rainbow bunny remains completely hidden.

findings.observation: Replace the old cut-based disappearance with the newly commissioned visible emergence. No accepted in-between frame exists in the overnight render.
replacement: Continue the accepted soap-covered scrub: the big bunny’s form is hidden under bubbles, and no part of the little rainbow bunny is visible.
The whole little rainbow bunny jumps out of the bubbles in one readable arc, first appearing now; simultaneously the old dusty casing collapses inward beneath the breaking foam.
The little bunny lands safely in front as the remaining big casing crumbles into low outward-scattering dust and the soap bubbles pop and thin; helpers pull their tools clear.

findings.observation: At f2504 the new friend is already on the floor; f2550 confirms reduced ears, missing pearl/curl details and simplified body. The concept must remain intact after landing.
replacement: Continue the exact accepted R10 endpoint: the little bunny has landed and the big casing is already collapsed into low drifting dust.
Over the next seconds the dust spreads gently outward near the floor and thins; the little bunny’s ears settle and the four helpers lower their tools.
The little friend smiles as the remaining dust settles into a faint floor residue; no intact giant or shell remains.

findings.observation: The small rainbow companion no longer carries all concept details and the paper action has little readable transfer at its endpoint.
replacement: Roshan pinches the corner of one visible paper scrap while the concept-matching bunny watches beside her.
She lifts the complete scrap from the floor in one uninterrupted movement.
She holds it clearly; the exact floor patch is now empty.

findings.observation: Native f2690-2729 shows Daddy’s raised duster mostly moving in clear space while the Eagle flaps. The target and removal are too hard to read. Independently, the Eagle identity must match the original book instead of the rejected redraw.
replacement: Daddy places the duster against a small visible web on the established column.
One careful sweep catches that same web in the fibers while Baby Eagle watches nearby.
Daddy lowers the duster with the web attached, revealing the cleaned column patch.

findings.observation: Consecutive f2786-2845 shows a persistent brown stain despite water and sponge contact; the cut provides no visible cleaned patch.
replacement: Rumi directs a small stream onto Roshan’s star sponge against the wall stain.
Roshan wipes one short path and the brown dirt transfers into the damp sponge.
Both stop so the clean patch and remaining edge can be seen.

findings.observation: At f2910 the bunny has a prominent amber forehead jewel, small paws and different ear/body treatment. This is an identity failure, not simply a small-scale loss of detail.
replacement: With the same concept-matching rainbow bunny beside Roshan, the team completes one short floor-cleaning pass.
Roshan’s sponge follows Daddy’s broom along the visible dirty patch while Rumi and Eagle watch the result.
The tools settle and the clean patch remains visible; the bunny gives one tiny happy bob.

findings.observation: Frame 2980 still carries the redesigned bunny in the final wide. A tiny character must preserve its large identifying silhouette and color placement.
replacement: Start with all five friends together in the restored Hall B.
They lean gently toward the concept-matching rainbow bunny for one shared happy reaction.
The group settles, keeping the same door emblems and open Royal arch visible.

findings.observation: Owner rejected the derived Eagle reference. Native film frames preserve the redraw’s altered proportions and pointed talons; restore original book identity without changing the established rescue story.
replacement: Begin with the book-matching Eagle low on the floor and exactly two soft dust bunnies pinning her two wings.
Eagle raises her head toward Roshan with a readable worried look, preserving rounded plush feet and the book beak and feather pattern.
Roshan looks toward both pinning bunnies; neither pin releases in this discovery shot.

findings.observation: Owner rejected the derived Eagle reference. Native film frames preserve the redraw’s altered proportions and pointed talons; restore original book identity without changing the established rescue story.
replacement: In the already-restored room, Roshan’s hand rests gently beside the recovered book-matching Eagle; neither dust-bunny pin is present.
Eagle opens her two pink black-tipped wings for one small joyful wingbeat, preserving the original soft body proportions and rounded silver-grey feet.
Eagle lands and folds her wings with a supported settle beside Roshan.

retained_candidates.reason: Journey, otter climb/greeting, full high-five and new tail-preserving arrival remain narrative retain candidates; aircraft size/style differences remain secondary review issues.
Bathroom problem reads; use its fixture family to anchor the clean setup.
Dirty pool, clogged waterfall and seahorse obstruction are legible; no need to restore old wrong-creature variants.
Rumi rise/approach/hug remains the strongest emotional beat; recheck incoming clean-water endpoint after R05.
Dirty-room establish retained; Eagle pinned and recovered imagery now has separate owner-directed identity repairs R17/R18. Preserve the established two-pin rescue and recovery story.
Art establish shows the loose supplies; use it as state comparison, not automatically approved IMAGE_1.
Four room trails and Grand Puff setup remain legible; preserve progression and arena continuity.
Pool recap reuses the earned hug; keep unless Rumi source needs regeneration.
Final family hug remains retain candidate; no rainbow bunny visible in this shot.

limits: Retain means no new regeneration commission from reviewed samples. No all-frame, human, at-speed, audio, runtime or device acceptance is granted.
